frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete small early mammal with compact trunk and robust scratch-digging forelimbs; not isolated claws or skeleton.
uncertainties: LACM 150948 comprises jaws, incomplete cranium and about 40 percent of the postcranial skeleton. It is not a complete preserved skeleton.
Full outline, ears, fur, tail completion and coloration are reconstructed; they must not be presented as preserved soft tissue.
Basal mammalian placement is not resolved here. Do not label this animal an armadillo, anteater or confirmed placental.
Scratch-digging and specialized feeding interpretations are supported by limb and tooth anatomy; exact diet remains interpretive. No detailed exposed dentition is required.
Total length of approximately 16 cm is a published skeletal reconstruction estimate, not a measured holotype body length.
